reviews.t: Mirror is not acrylic-it's REAL GLASS that can shatter.
reviews.x: There is nothing wrong with this item except for the description.  If you want a real mirror that looks great- buy this item.  However, this item is listed as "reflective acrylic." It's NOT acrylic-it's REAL GLASS that can break easily.  I thought I was purchasing a safe mirror that will be used by children, and this mirror, if dropped or if it is on the inside of a locker that is slammed, will break.  Other than the product description, it appears to be a well made product.
I got it for my daughter (she started 6th grade) and she loves it. It is well made and stays put on her locker door.

reviews.t: Magnet glued on backwards.. doesn't stick to fridge.

I ended up having to glue some random magnets to it to make it stick which irritated me enough to write this review. Seriously... put the magnet on correctly or your product

As always this item arrived on time and was well packaged from Amazon. However, the mirror had several small chips along the edge of the glass - not a big deal since it's being used in a garage. However, my plan was to mount this to a steel cabinet using the magnets glued to the back of the glass. These magnets are a joke, they couldn't even support the weight of the mirror, without sliding down the cabinet door.

Biggest waste of money since trash bags. I buy trash bags just to throw away, and thats exactly what I ended up doing with the cheap item. Magnet hardly worked. I barely touched it and it would fall. reviews.t: This is a joke. The so-called magnets are about ...
reviews.x: This is a joke. The so-called magnets are about 2% of the strength of a typical magnet. I tried to put it on the side of my refrigerator, and it instantly fell off.  There are 2 strips on the back that are supposedly magnetic, but are not. I don't get it.  What are they? Why did they even put any sort of a strip on the back if it wasn't going to be magnetic?  I even tried to pick up the mirror by the so-called magnet using one of those magnetic fishing games -- nothing.  It's not magnetic.
